intro: The Bills beat the Vikings 23-6 on Monday night to reach 7-1, and the Eagles lost Jalen Hurts for the season to blood clots. Thursday night brings the Commanders to the Giants, and the Broncos head into a bye after setting a record for one-score wins. 160 stories across all 32 teams.

top.label: Biggest Story
top.headline: Bills grind out 23-6 win over Vikings on Monday night
top.dek: Buffalo moved to 7-1 in Minneapolis. Josh Allen hit Keleki Latu for a 25-yard touchdown just before halftime, and the defense picked off two passes while Minnesota struggled to move the ball.

top.label: Injury Watch
top.headline: Jalen Hurts is out for the season with blood clots
top.dek: Hurts has deep vein thrombosis and clots in both lungs, and blood thinners rule out contact. ESPN reports he is clinically stable. The Eagles sit at 2-7 and head into their bye.

top.label: Player Spotlight
top.headline: Ja'Marr Chase piles up 155 yards in Madrid
top.dek: Chase caught 10 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown against Atlanta. He had 142 of those yards in the first half, including a 47-yard score in the first quarter, as the Bengals won 34-17.

top.label: Stat of the Day
top.headline: 16: straight one-score wins for Denver, an NFL record
top.dek: The Broncos have won 16 consecutive regular-season games decided by one score. The 26-21 win in Carolina added the latest one, and Denver now takes its bye at 7-2.

top.label: What's Next
top.headline: Commanders visit the Giants on Thursday Night Football
top.dek: Washington plays at MetLife Stadium on Thursday, Nov. 12, at 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video. The Giants are 5-2-1 and the teams tied 27-27 in Week 5.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.headline: Bills run past Vikings to reach 7-1

stories.text: Bills grind out 23-6 win over Vikings on Monday night
stories.summary: Buffalo moved to 7-1 with a 23-6 win in Minneapolis. Josh Allen hit Keleki Latu for a 25-yard touchdown just before halftime, and the defense piled up two interceptions while the Vikings struggled to move the ball.

stories.text: Bills played without two starting linemen in Minnesota
stories.summary: Left tackle Dion Dawkins (ribs) and left guard Alec Anderson (ankle) were both inactive Monday night. Buffalo now watches their practice participation this week ahead of Sunday's trip to the Jets.

stories.text: James Cook carries the load with 107 yards on 31 rushes
stories.summary: Cook ran 31 times for 107 yards and added a late touchdown, grinding the clock in a game where the passing offense stayed quiet. Linebackers Terrel Bernard and Dorian Williams each picked off a pass.

stories.text: 322: Josh Allen ties Peyton Manning for touchdowns through 10 seasons
stories.summary: Allen's touchdown to Latu gave him 322 regular-season scores (232 passing, 88 rushing, 2 receiving). That ties Manning for the most by any player in his first 10 years.

stories.text: Bills visit the Jets on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Buffalo (7-1) plays at MetLife Stadium against a Jets team that is 2-7. Watch how the Bills handle the line while Dawkins and Anderson recover.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.headline: Dolphins' offense stalls in 19-9 loss to Lions

stories.text: Dolphins lose 19-9 to Lions as the offense finds no end zone
stories.summary: Miami's defense held Detroit to 270 yards, but the offense scored no touchdowns and drew five holding penalties and three false starts. A missed field goal at the end of the first half hurt, and the Dolphins fell to 1-7.

stories.text: Malik Willis plays through a tight groin and awaits a medical update
stories.summary: Willis said his groin was tight against the Lions, and it limited his scrambling. Coach Jeff Hafley has no update yet, so Kyle McCord could see more work if Willis cannot go against the Colts.

stories.text: Jacob Rodriguez leads the defense with 10 tackles and a sack
stories.summary: The linebacker was the busiest player on a defense that kept the game close. Rookie Chris Johnson also intercepted his first pass of the season.

stories.text: 170: Jared Goff's season-low passing yards against Miami
stories.summary: The Dolphins held Goff to 170 yards with no touchdowns. Coach Jeff Hafley called it the defense's best game of the season, and the offense could not use it.

stories.text: Dolphins visit the Colts on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Miami (1-7) travels to Lucas Oil Stadium to face Indianapolis (2-7). Willis' groin is the main thing to watch before kickoff.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.headline: Maye's three picks sink Patriots in 45-27 loss

stories.text: Packers rout Patriots 45-27 as Maye throws three first-half picks
stories.summary: New England fell behind 24-7 in the second quarter at Gillette Stadium and never recovered. Drake Maye has 11 interceptions in nine games, the most in the NFL.

stories.text: Guard Ben Brown unlikely for Germany, Stevenson awaits MRI
stories.summary: Brown hurt his knee against Green Bay, and coach Mike Vrabel does not expect him to play against the Lions. Running back Rhamondre Stevenson is getting an MRI on his knee, and receiver A.J. Brown remains uncertain for Munich.

stories.text: Drake Maye throws for 299 yards and 3 TDs, but 3 INTs
stories.summary: Maye went 21 of 38 for 299 yards and three touchdowns, with three interceptions. The yardage and scores were there. The turnovers decided the game.

stories.text: 187: Receiving yards Christian Gonzalez allowed to Green Bay
stories.summary: Gonzalez gave up a career-high 10 catches on 11 targets for 187 yards against the Packers. It was a rough day for a corner who usually shadows the top receiver.

stories.text: Patriots face the Lions in Munich on Sunday at 9:30 a.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: New England (5-4) plays Detroit (6-2) at Allianz Arena. The team flies a day early, with a walkthrough Thursday and practice Friday.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.headline: Jets fall 35-12 at Kansas City, drop to 2-7

stories.text: Chiefs pull away from Jets 35-12 at Arrowhead
stories.summary: The Jets sit at 2-7 after kicking four field goals and nothing else. Geno Smith went 18 of 32 for 165 yards and took five sacks as Kansas City ran away in the second half.

stories.text: Garrett Wilson sat out with a concussion, Breece Hall returned
stories.summary: Wilson missed the Chiefs game in concussion protocol after a hit against the Raiders. Hall came back after five weeks out with a quad injury and finished with 87 scrimmage yards. Wilson's status for Buffalo is not yet known.

stories.text: David Bailey keeps rushing the passer with 2 sacks at KC
stories.summary: Bailey had two sacks, three QB hits and two forced fumbles. His 7.5 sacks through nine games are the second most by a Jet since 1982.

stories.text: 12: Points, all from Jason Sanders' four field goals
stories.summary: Sanders hit from 23, 48, 49 and 54 yards, and the Jets never found the end zone. A two-point halftime deficit grew to a 23-point loss.

stories.text: Jets host the Bills on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: New York (2-7) plays Buffalo (7-1) at MetLife Stadium. Watch whether Wilson clears the concussion protocol.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.headline: Ravens sink to 4-5 with Jackson on IR

stories.text: Ravens lose a fifth straight as offense stalls without Jackson
stories.summary: Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano made his first start Thursday night and Jacksonville won 33-10. Baltimore has now lost three straight games by 20 or more points, a first in franchise history. Lamar Jackson went on injured reserve with a thumb injury and will miss at least three more games.

stories.text: Hamilton, Wiggins and Hawkins get a read when players return Tuesday
stories.summary: Coach Jesse Minter sounds hopeful that safety Kyle Hamilton avoids missed time. Cornerback Nate Wiggins and safety Jaylinn Hawkins, who has missed three games, will be evaluated when the team returns Tuesday. Fagnano played through an ankle injury, and Jackson's thumb recovery stays private.

stories.text: Justice Hill grinds out 85 yards in the loss
stories.summary: Running back Justice Hill carried for 85 yards and scored in Baltimore's 33-10 loss to Jacksonville. He gave the Ravens one of their few steady plays on a night when the passing game produced almost nothing.

stories.text: 55: Ravens passing yards against Jacksonville, their fewest in nine years
stories.summary: Fagnano averaged 3.3 yards per attempt and threw only one pass longer than 10 yards. Baltimore has now scored 14 or fewer points in four straight games, a team record. The Ravens also lead the NFL with 24 false starts.

stories.text: Ravens host winless Chargers on Monday night
stories.summary: Baltimore plays the Los Angeles Chargers at M&T Bank Stadium on Monday, Nov. 16 at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN. The Ravens get an 11-day break after Thursday's loss. Watch who plays quarterback and whether the offense scores more than 14.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.headline: Burrow and Chase light up Madrid, Bengals 6-2

stories.text: Bengals beat Falcons 34-17 in Madrid to reach 6-2
stories.summary: Joe Burrow went 24 of 29 for 271 yards and three touchdowns with no turnovers, and added a rushing score. Cincinnati sits tied with Pittsburgh atop the AFC North. The Steelers visit Sunday night.

stories.text: Rookie edge Howell on IR, Dugger misses another game
stories.summary: Second-round rookie Cashius Howell went on injured reserve after wrist surgery. Safety Kyle Dugger missed his second straight game with a quad injury. Cedric Johnson (ankle) was questionable heading into the Madrid game.

stories.text: Ja'Marr Chase piles up 155 yards in Spain
stories.summary: Chase caught 10 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown against Atlanta. He had 142 of those yards in the first half, including a 47-yard score in the first quarter.

stories.text: 142: Chase's first-half yards, best by a Bengals receiver since 1988
stories.summary: No Cincinnati receiver had a bigger half in 38 years. Burrow also leads the NFL in completion percentage and touchdown passes. He is the first Bengal to throw 20 touchdown passes in the team's first seven games.

stories.text: Steelers visit Paycor Stadium on Sunday night
stories.summary: Cincinnati plays Pittsburgh on Sunday, Nov. 15 at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC. The Steelers already beat the Bengals once this season. First place in the AFC North is at stake for both teams.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.headline: Browns fall in OT as 2-point try fails

stories.text: Saints beat Browns 23-22 in overtime
stories.summary: Cleveland forced overtime on a 51-yard Andre Szmyt field goal, but New Orleans scored first in the extra period. Harold Fannin Jr. caught a 39-yard touchdown late in overtime, and the two-point attempt that would have won it failed. The Browns drop to 5-4.

stories.text: Watson clears concussion protocol, expected to return as QB1
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson did not clear concussion protocol until Saturday and sat out Sunday's game. A source says the Browns plan to start him against Houston, though coach Todd Monken had not announced it Monday.

stories.text: Carson Schwesinger records 15 tackles and 2 sacks
stories.summary: The linebacker was the best player on the field for Cleveland in New Orleans. He also forced a fumble. The Browns committed no turnovers but still lost.

stories.text: 297: Shedeur Sanders' passing yards in his start for Watson
stories.summary: Sanders completed 19 of 31 passes with two touchdowns, including a 64-yard score to rookie KC Concepcion. He took five sacks. His QBR was 39.

stories.text: Texans visit Cleveland on Sunday at 1 p.m.
stories.summary: The Browns host Houston at FirstEnergy Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 15 at 1:00 p.m. ET on FOX. Watch the quarterback decision and whether the pass rush keeps up its pace.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.headline: Steelers use bye to rework passing game

stories.text: Steelers retool the passing game during the bye
stories.summary: Pittsburgh is 6-2 and has won four straight, but coordinator Brian Angelichio called the passing game a work in progress. The staff spent the bye asking whether the concepts fit Aaron Rodgers and the receivers. The Steelers already beat Cincinnati once this year.

stories.text: Pittman is running but has no return date
stories.summary: Receiver Michael Pittman Jr. has missed four games on injured reserve with a left foot injury. He progressed from the treadmill to cleats but says he will not play until he is effective. He does not appear close to a return.

stories.text: Jaylen Warren rushes for 143 yards against Cleveland
stories.summary: Warren carried 17 times for 143 yards in the 27-6 win on Nov. 1, tying his career high. He also scored on a 58-yard catch from Rodgers.

stories.text: 8: sacks by the Steelers defense in the win over Cleveland
stories.summary: T.J. Watt had two of them, giving him 20.5 career sacks against the Browns, the most any player has had against them. Cleveland ran for only 34 yards.

stories.text: Steelers visit Bengals on Sunday Night Football
stories.summary: Pittsburgh was on bye in Week 9. It plays at Cincinnati on Sunday, Nov. 15 at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC. First place in the AFC North is on the line.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.headline: Stroud's five TDs bury the winless Chargers

stories.text: Texans roll 44-22 in first game after the bye
stories.summary: Houston went to SoFi Stadium and ran over the winless Chargers. C.J. Stroud finished 21 of 35 for 384 yards and five touchdowns with one interception, and Kayshon Boutte caught two scores. The Texans are 3-5 and 3-1 on the road.

stories.text: Stingley hurt late, Dell back on the field
stories.summary: Cornerback Derek Stingley Jr. went down late in the win over Los Angeles, and the postgame reports gave no status for him. Watch the first practice report of the week. Wide receiver Tank Dell is back from his knee injury and played his second game since returning.

stories.text: Tank Dell earns a game ball in his second game back
stories.summary: Dell topped 100 receiving yards and scored against the Chargers, his first touchdown since the 2024 knee injury. DeMeco Ryans praised the work Dell put in away from the cameras. Stroud said he is proud of how Dell stayed the course.

stories.text: 8: sacks of Justin Herbert, a career high for him
stories.summary: The Texans sacked Herbert eight times, the most he has taken in a game. He now has 31 sacks this season, second most in the league. Houston's pass rush gave Stroud and the offense short fields all afternoon.

stories.text: Texans visit the Browns on Sunday
stories.summary: Houston plays at Cleveland on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 1:00 p.m. ET on Fox. The Texans are 3-1 on the road this season and want to keep the offense rolling after a 44-point day.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.headline: Colts lose a fifth straight, 27-23 to Dallas

stories.text: Colts blow a chance and fall to 2-7
stories.summary: Dallas led by 10 in the third quarter, Javonte Williams scored the go-ahead touchdown, and Caleb Downs intercepted Daniel Jones to seal a 27-23 win at Lucas Oil Stadium. The Cowboys committed 14 penalties and two turnovers and still escaped. Indianapolis had five three-and-outs in its first six drives.

stories.text: Four defensive players missed the Dallas game
stories.summary: Cornerback Justin Walley (knee) and linebacker Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee) were ruled out. Walley has not practiced since he got hurt in Week 7. Safety AJ Haulcy (ankle) was downgraded to out the day before, and tackle Jalen Travis (thumb, hamstring) was questionable.

stories.text: Laiatu Latu forces his first fumble of the year
stories.summary: Latu stripped the ball from the Cowboys' quarterback, and the takeaway gave the Colts the ball in the red zone for the game's opening score. It was his first forced fumble this season.

stories.text: 10: interceptions for Daniel Jones, against six touchdowns
stories.summary: Jones went 20 of 34 for 180 yards, one touchdown and one interception against Dallas. He completes about 60 percent of his passes this season. The Colts are not planning to move him at the deadline, and he is still working back from the Achilles tear that ended his 2025 season.

stories.text: Colts host the 1-7 Dolphins on Sunday
stories.summary: Indianapolis hosts Miami on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 1:00 p.m. ET on CBS. Both teams are looking for a way out of a long losing run, and the Colts have lost five in a row.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.headline: Jaguars flatten the Ravens 33-10 on Thursday

stories.text: Jaguars rout Baltimore on Thursday night
stories.summary: Jacksonville beat the Ravens 33-10 to move to 6-2. The defense held Baltimore to 227 total yards and 4 of 14 on third down, and forced three takeaways. Baltimore scored only on its opening drive until a 65-yard Justice Hill run.

stories.text: Hamilton and Murray are done for the season
stories.summary: Defensive tackle DaVon Hamilton (quadriceps) and safety Eric Murray (elbow) are out for the year after the Week 8 win over the Colts. Running back Bhayshul Tuten (ankle, foot) and edge rusher Travon Walker (rib) did not practice on that Monday report.

stories.text: Trevor Lawrence owns the league's best passer rating
stories.summary: Lawrence went 16 of 26 for 242 yards and a 50-yard touchdown to Parker Washington before halftime. His 111.7 rating leads the NFL, just ahead of Joe Burrow's 111.6. He has not thrown an interception in 10 quarters.

stories.text: 8: wins by 20 or more points since the start of 2025
stories.summary: That is the most in the NFL over the span. The Jaguars beat the Colts 42-7 in Week 8 and the Ravens by 23 in Week 9. Lawrence sat the fourth quarter against Indianapolis.

stories.text: Jaguars travel to Tennessee with extra rest
stories.summary: Jacksonville plays at the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 15, with a noon CT kickoff (1:00 p.m. ET) on Fox. The Jaguars had ten days between games after the Thursday night win.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.headline: Titans return from bye at 1-7 with a thin roster

stories.text: Saleh says the bye is for a reset after the Simmons trade
stories.summary: The Titans went into their bye 1-7 after an overtime loss at Cincinnati. Robert Saleh said the team has faced plenty of adversity, including close losses and the Jeffery Simmons trade to the Bears, and said players are still buying in. The offense is under 20 points per game and the defense ranks second worst in total yards allowed.

stories.text: Line and linebackers are thin as Saleh stays quiet
stories.summary: John Franklin-Myers has played through a back injury since early in the preseason. Tennessee finished the Cincinnati game with a patched offensive line and few healthy linebackers. Saleh said he would hold injury updates until closer to the Jaguars game.

stories.text: Cam Ward throws for 340 yards in the loss to Cincinnati
stories.summary: Ward went 26 of 40 for 340 yards and two touchdowns in the 43-36 overtime loss on Nov. 1. Tony Pollard ran for 117 yards and two scores in the same game.

stories.text: 3: interceptions for Amari Hooker, and Tennessee still lost
stories.summary: Hooker picked off Joe Burrow three times, yet Cincinnati won 43-36 in overtime. Burrow threw for 462 yards and five touchdowns in regulation, plus a rushing score in the extra period.

stories.text: Deadline day, then the Jaguars at Nissan Stadium
stories.summary: The NFL trade deadline falls today at 3 p.m. Nashville time. Tennessee hosts Jacksonville on Sunday, Nov. 15, at noon CT (1:00 p.m. ET) on Fox, its first game after the bye.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.headline: Five straight wins carry Denver into the bye

stories.text: Broncos hold off Carolina for a fifth straight win
stories.summary: Denver beat the Panthers 26-21 in Charlotte on Sunday and sits at 7-2 heading into its bye. Sean Payton's challenge wiped out a Carolina first-and-goal at the Denver 1 and turned it into a Devon Key interception. Nik Bonitto then strip-sacked Bryce Young with 1:24 left to seal it.

stories.text: Waddle and Moss leave with concussions
stories.summary: Receiver Jaylen Waddle and cornerback Riley Moss both suffered first-half concussions in Charlotte and did not return. Waddle was already playing through leg and chest injuries. Safeties Talanoa Hufanga and Brandon Jones also sat out, and the bye gives all four extra time.

stories.text: Pat Bryant returns from IR with a touchdown
stories.summary: Bryant came off injured reserve and caught a 26-yard touchdown, the biggest play of his 56-yard day. His score came in his first game back and helped Denver cover for Waddle's early exit. Bo Nix finished with two touchdown passes and went 6 of 10 on third down, a season best.

stories.text: 16: straight one-score wins, an NFL record
stories.summary: Denver has now won 16 consecutive regular-season games decided by one score, an NFL record. The 26-21 win in Carolina added the latest one. The Broncos are also 3-2 on the road this season.

stories.text: Bye in Week 10, then the Raiders
stories.summary: Denver is off this week. The Broncos return to host the Las Vegas Raiders on November 22. Today's 2 p.m. ET trade deadline may bring a move at running back or tight end.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.headline: Chiefs snap skid, then watch Mahomes' elbow

stories.text: Chiefs rout the Jets 35-12 to end a two-game skid
stories.summary: Kansas City led 14-12 at halftime, then scored twice in the third quarter to pull away at Arrowhead. The win moves the Chiefs to 6-2 after losses to Seattle and Denver. The defense sacked Geno Smith five times, a season high.

stories.text: Mahomes day-to-day with elbow sprain
stories.summary: An MRI showed no major damage to Patrick Mahomes' throwing elbow, and he is day-to-day with a strain or sprain. Andy Reid said Mahomes will be monitored before the trip to Atlanta. Receiver Xavier Worthy (hamstring) and tackle Jaylon Moore (ankle) also left the game.

stories.text: Kenneth Walker III scores three times
stories.summary: Walker ran for 102 yards on 18 carries, caught four passes for 41 yards and scored three touchdowns. Both of Mahomes' touchdown passes went to him. It was the third three-touchdown game of his career.

stories.text: 9,360: Mahomes and Kelce set a QB-TE yards record
stories.summary: Mahomes and Travis Kelce passed the NFL record for combined quarterback-tight end passing and receiving yards, reaching 9,360. Kelce caught four passes for 72 yards against the Jets. Chris Jones also reached 90 career sacks, second in franchise history behind Derrick Thomas.

stories.text: At Atlanta, Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: The Chiefs visit the Falcons on Sunday, November 15. Watch Mahomes' practice reps this week. If his work is limited, Justin Fields takes the first-team snaps.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.headline: Five turnovers sink Raiders in the Bay Area

stories.text: Raiders fall 38-17 to the 49ers on five giveaways
stories.summary: Las Vegas trailed only 21-10 at halftime, then turned the ball over five times in the second half. Kirk Cousins threw a pick-six on the first play of the third quarter and finished with three interceptions. The Raiders dropped to 4-5 with eight games left.

stories.text: Guard Trey Zuhn leaves with a concussion
stories.summary: Guard Trey Zuhn III was ruled out of the 49ers game with a concussion. He will have to clear the league protocol before facing Seattle on Sunday. No other new Raiders injuries were reported from the game.

stories.text: Brock Bowers posts 111 yards in a lost cause
stories.summary: Bowers caught seven passes for 111 yards and a 21-yard touchdown in the third quarter. He also lost a fumble in the second half, and tight end Michael Mayer lost one just short of the goal line. The Raiders ran 15 times for 24 yards.

stories.text: 6: straight games allowing 30 points, tying an NFL record
stories.summary: The Raiders defense has given up 30 or more points in six straight games, which ties an NFL record. Las Vegas has lost five of those six after a 3-0 start. San Francisco scored 38 on Sunday.

stories.text: Seahawks at Allegiant, Sunday at 4:05 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Las Vegas hosts Seattle on Sunday, November 15. Watch whether the Raiders protect the football after five giveaways and whether the ground game, 24 yards on 15 carries Sunday, improves.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.headline: Winless Chargers get crushed by Houston

stories.text: Chargers fall to 0-8 after a 44-22 loss to Houston
stories.summary: The Texans led 38-9 at their peak at SoFi Stadium, and the Chargers sit winless at the season's halfway point. C.J. Stroud threw for 384 yards and five touchdowns. Pressure is building on coach Jim Harbaugh, offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel and quarterback Justin Herbert.

stories.text: Herbert's finger, McConkey's back, three hurt corners
stories.summary: Justin Herbert hurt his left middle finger, and Harbaugh said he does not expect it to linger. Ladd McConkey missed the game with back spasms from pregame warmups. Cornerback Isas Waxter (ankle) was ruled out, and Cam Hart and Justin Eboigbe left with ankle injuries.

stories.text: Quentin Johnston supplies the lone bright spot
stories.summary: Johnston turned a short Herbert pass into a 58-yard touchdown, the longest play of the Chargers' season. It was the team's first touchdown since the third quarter of Week 5. With McConkey out, Johnston led a thin receiver group.

stories.text: 8: sacks of Herbert, a career high
stories.summary: Houston sacked Herbert eight times for 40 yards lost. Will Anderson, Sheldon Rankins and Jadeveon Clowney had two each. The Chargers also converted just 5 of 17 third downs.

stories.text: At Baltimore, Monday at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN
stories.summary: The Chargers play the Ravens on Monday Night Football on November 16, their first primetime game of the season. It is a chance to end the winless start. The Jets, Patriots and Buccaneers follow.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.headline: Cowboys survive Colts, face 49ers next

stories.text: Cowboys escape Indianapolis with a 27-23 win
stories.summary: Dallas blew a 17-7 halftime lead before Javonte Williams scored from one yard out with 1:26 left. The Cowboys outgained the Colts 508 to 271 but still needed a late drive to get to 4-5. Their fourth-quarter mistakes, not the final score, are what the locker room is discussing.

stories.text: Ferguson and Goodson face multiple weeks out; Locke is out Sunday
stories.summary: Tight end Jake Ferguson (knee) and running back Tyler Goodson (knee, plus a second issue found in postgame testing) are expected to miss multiple weeks. Safety P.J. Locke has his second concussion in two weeks and is out against the 49ers. George Pickens (hamstring) sat out the Colts game and is in the rehab group, with the team deciding his status for Sunday.

stories.text: CeeDee Lamb piles up 195 yards despite a costly fumble
stories.summary: Lamb caught 10 passes for 195 yards and a touchdown in Indianapolis. He also drew two offensive pass interference flags and fumbled in the fourth quarter, a play first ruled down before a review overturned it. He said afterward he should have done more to close the game out.

stories.text: 14: penalties for 153 yards against the Colts
stories.summary: Dallas flagged itself 14 times for 153 yards while winning a game it controlled for more than 35 minutes. Brandon Aubrey also missed a 50-yard field goal that would have tied the score at 23 late. Discipline is now the loudest complaint around a 4-5 team.

stories.text: Cowboys host the 49ers Sunday at AT&T Stadium
stories.summary: Dallas plays San Francisco on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX. Watch the secondary and tight end depth, since Locke is out and Ferguson is sidelined. Dallas has its bye in Week 14.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.headline: Giants win in Philly, lead the NFC East

stories.text: Giants beat Eagles 19-11 and hold the NFC East lead
stories.summary: New York went into Philadelphia and won 19-11, its first win there since 2013. The Giants are 5-2-1 in Harbaugh's first season as head coach, while the Eagles fell to 2-7. The offense leaned on kicker Dominic Zvada, who made four field goals.

stories.text: McCarthy's hip and Skattebo's hamstring are the Thursday questions
stories.summary: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy left the Eagles game briefly with a hip issue, and Jameis Winston threw a touchdown to Isaiah Likely in his place. Coach Harbaugh said McCarthy looks likely to play Thursday but is not confirmed. Running back Cam Skattebo (hamstring) was close to playing Sunday and should be full go.

stories.text: Arvell Reese terrorizes Philadelphia with three sacks
stories.summary: The rookie linebacker had three sacks and 12 tackles. He became only the second Giants rookie with 3.0 sacks in a game since sacks became official in 1982. Joe Milton went down seven times on the day.

stories.text: 7: sacks the Giants took of Joe Milton
stories.summary: The Giants sacked Milton seven times for 41 yards, with Reese taking three. Milton finished 18 of 34 for 169 yards and no touchdowns. Philadelphia had six sacks of its own, so the game came down to pressure on both sides.

stories.text: Giants host Washington on Thursday Night Football
stories.summary: New York hosts the 2-5-1 Commanders on Thursday, Nov. 12, at 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video at MetLife Stadium. The teams tied 27-27 in Week 5. The Giants ask fans to wear white and will wear Vintage White uniforms.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.headline: Eagles at 2-7 weigh changes in bye week

stories.text: Sirianni weighs staff changes as losing streak hits seven
stories.summary: The Eagles enter their bye last in the NFC East after a seventh straight loss. Coach Nick Sirianni said changes, including staff moves, are on the table and plans to simplify the offense. First-year play caller Sean Mannion is under scrutiny, though Sirianni says responsibility is shared.

stories.text: Hurts is out for the season with blood clots
stories.summary: Jalen Hurts has deep vein thrombosis and clots in both lungs, and he is on blood thinners that rule out contact and even light running. ESPN reports he is clinically stable. DeVonta Smith is also dealing with a hamstring injury, and the offensive line has lost several players.

stories.text: Joe Milton runs for 64 yards in his first start
stories.summary: Milton, released from the Cowboys practice squad in mid-October, went 18 of 34 for 169 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions. He added 64 rushing yards, including runs of 19 and 24, and scored a goal-line touchdown. Receivers dropped four or five catchable passes.

stories.text: 11: points in a fourth straight loss by eight or more
stories.summary: Since Hurts went down, Philadelphia has scored 14, 21, 10 and 11 points and lost each game by at least eight. The Eagles have not topped 24 points in any game this season and rank third from the bottom in scoring. Philadelphia scored no touchdown after halftime against the Giants.

stories.text: Eagles are on bye, then host the Steelers Nov. 22
stories.summary: Philadelphia is off in Week 10. Pittsburgh visits Sunday, Nov. 22, at 1 p.m. ET on CBS in a game recently moved from the late window. The Steelers are 6-2, and a trip to Dallas follows.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.headline: Commanders fall short to Rams, host TNF

stories.text: Commanders lose 20-13 to Rams, then turn to a short week
stories.summary: Washington led early but stalled after the second quarter, and its final play fell short from the Rams 31 with three seconds left. The Commanders are 2-5-1. A rematch with the Giants comes Thursday, four days later.

stories.text: McLaurin and Brown are on injured reserve; Burks is questionable
stories.summary: Terry McLaurin is on injured reserve after surgery to repair a torn patellar tendon, which GM Adam Peters called successful. Dyami Brown went to injured reserve with a calf injury, and Treylon Burks (foot) is questionable for Thursday. Running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt is out until at least Week 12.

stories.text: Frankie Luvu posts 15 tackles and a sack
stories.summary: The linebacker finished with 15 tackles, seven solo, and added a sack and two tackles for loss. The defense held the Rams to 3 of 14 on third down. It was not enough because the offense went quiet after early scores.

stories.text: 157: yards on the first three drives, out of 313 total
stories.summary: Washington gained 157 of its 313 yards on its first three possessions, then punted on nearly every drive after the second-quarter touchdown. The last two drives ended on a turnover on downs and a fumble. The Rams ran 29 times for 124 yards to control the clock.

stories.text: Commanders visit the Giants on Thursday Night Football
stories.summary: Washington plays at MetLife Stadium on Thursday, Nov. 12, at 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video, four days after the Rams loss. The Giants are 5-2-1, and the teams tied 27-27 in Week 5. Watch the offensive line, where center Lucas Patrick is doubtful.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.headline: Santos wins it as time expires, Bears 7-2

stories.text: Bears survive five turnovers to beat Tampa Bay 27-24
stories.summary: Caleb Williams threw a career-high four interceptions, then hit Colston Loveland for 38 yards as time ran out. Cairo Santos kicked the 38-yard winner, and Chicago improved to 7-2 with its fourth straight win. The Bears now take their bye.

stories.text: Burden leaves with concussion, Stevenson hurts thumb
stories.summary: Rookie receiver Luther Burden caught seven passes for 97 yards and a 56-yard touchdown before a concussion ended his night. Cornerback Tyrique Stevenson also left with a thumb injury. The bye gives both extra time before the Nov. 22 game.

stories.text: Jaylon Johnson takes his first pick of the year 67 yards to the house
stories.summary: Johnson picked off Baker Mayfield and returned it 67 yards for a touchdown, the second pick-six of his career. Mayfield threw two interceptions in the game. The Bears forced the turnover swing that kept them afloat despite Williams' four giveaways.

stories.text: 22.8%: Chicago's third-down defense leads the NFL
stories.summary: The Bears allow the lowest third-down conversion rate in the league. Tampa Bay converted 2 of 12 on Sunday. Chicago has allowed 21 third-down conversions all season, the second fewest through nine games since at least 1991.

stories.text: Bye week, then the Saints at Soldier Field
stories.summary: Chicago is off in Week 10. The Bears return Nov. 22 at home against New Orleans. Expect the staff to use the break to clean up the turnovers and get Burden through the concussion protocol.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.headline: Lions top Miami 19-9 for fourth straight win

stories.text: Lions grind out a 19-9 win at Miami
stories.summary: Detroit beat the Dolphins at Hard Rock Stadium for its fourth straight win and moved to 6-2. Jake Bates made all four field goals and Jahmyr Gibbs added a rushing touchdown. The Lions held the ball for 31:15 and held Miami to 228 yards.

stories.text: Jack Campbell lands on injured reserve after neck injury
stories.summary: The linebacker landed face down on the turf after a hit on Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson on Nov. 1 and left on a board. Detroit placed him on injured reserve Saturday. Campbell says he has full movement in his lower body and calls himself very optimistic.

stories.text: Gibbs scores again, now at 11 scrimmage touchdowns
stories.summary: Gibbs carried 20 times for 74 yards and an 8-yard touchdown against Miami. It was his 11th touchdown from scrimmage this season. Amon-Ra St. Brown caught eight passes for 86 yards.

stories.text: 54: Dan Campbell's win total moves him up the Lions list
stories.summary: The win over Miami was Campbell's 54th as Detroit's head coach in the regular season. That puts him alone in second place in franchise history. Only Wayne Fontes, with 66, has more.

stories.text: Patriots in Munich, Sunday 9:30 a.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Detroit plays New England at FC Bayern Munich Arena on Sunday, Nov. 15, in the Lions' Week 10 international game. Kickoff is 9:30 a.m. ET and the game airs on FOX. Watch how the Lions handle the travel and an early body clock.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.headline: Packers hang 45 on Patriots, lose Jacobs

stories.text: Packers rout Patriots 45-27 on the road
stories.summary: Green Bay forced four turnovers and piled up 478 yards at Gillette Stadium to move to 6-3. Jordan Love went 23 of 29 for 372 yards and three touchdowns. Karl Brooks had two of the defense's four sacks of Drake Maye.

stories.text: Josh Jacobs needs surgery on a fractured finger
stories.summary: Jacobs hurt his finger after four carries at New England and told the staff he had no grip strength. Coach Matt LaFleur said the surgery should happen this week and did not rule out injured reserve, which means at least four weeks. Chris Brooks has a good chance to return from IR, and Kaleb Johnson ran for 68 yards and a score against the Patriots.

stories.text: Watson and Golden combine for 335 yards
stories.summary: Christian Watson caught seven passes for 171 yards and Matthew Golden caught 10 for 164. Together they had 17 catches on 18 targets and two touchdowns. They are the first Packers pair to each top 150 yards with a score in one game since 1942.

stories.text: 478: Green Bay's road yardage is a first since 1962
stories.summary: The Packers gained 478 total yards and scored 45 points on the road. Packers.com says that is the first road output of that size for the franchise since 1962. Kicker Trey Smack went 3 for 3 on field goals, including a 51-yarder.

stories.text: Vikings at Lambeau, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Green Bay hosts Minnesota on Sunday, Nov. 15, with kickoff at 12 p.m. CT (1 p.m. ET) on FOX. The Vikings arrive 6-2 after a 23-6 loss to Buffalo. Watch the Packers' running back plan without Jacobs.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.headline: Offense stalls in 23-6 loss to Bills

stories.text: Bills beat Vikings 23-6 on Monday night
stories.summary: Carson Wentz started for the injured Kyler Murray and went 8 of 25 for 81 yards with three turnovers. Max Brosmer replaced him midway through the fourth quarter. Minnesota fell to 6-2, its second straight loss.

stories.text: Murray's hamstring strain hangs over the Packers game
stories.summary: An MRI confirmed a hamstring strain after Murray got hurt on a read-option run at Detroit. Kevin O'Connell said the team will not risk a bigger injury, and the Vikings hope he can return Nov. 15 at Green Bay. Receiver Jauan Jennings (calf) and safety Theo Jackson (quadriceps) were inactive Monday.

stories.text: Justin Jefferson gets 11 targets, catches three
stories.summary: Jefferson finished with three catches for 58 yards on 11 targets against Buffalo. The Vikings gained just 178 total yards. Minnesota's defense kept the game close for a while with four sacks.

stories.text: 0-for-7: Minnesota never converted a third down
stories.summary: The Vikings went 0 for 7 on third down while Buffalo held the ball for 42:32. Minnesota totaled 178 yards, and Wentz also lost a fumble that Buffalo turned into a field goal.

stories.text: At Green Bay, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Minnesota visits the Packers on Sunday, Nov. 15 with kickoff at 12 p.m. CT (1 p.m. ET) on FOX. Whether Murray or Wentz starts is the question to watch. The Vikings blitzed on 73.6 percent of dropbacks through seven games.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.headline: Falcons flag themselves out of Madrid

stories.text: Penalties sink Falcons in 34-17 loss to Bengals
stories.summary: Atlanta dropped to 3-6 in Madrid after committing a season-high 12 penalties. An early holding call erased a gain that would have put the offense at the 1-yard line, and kicker Nick Folk missed another field goal in the second half. Joe Burrow went 24 of 29 for 271 yards and three touchdowns against a defense that let Cincinnati pull away after halftime.

stories.text: Falcons report no new injuries after Madrid
stories.summary: Receiver Zachariah Branch and defensive back Billy Bowman Jr. were the Week 9 inactives, and no new injuries came out of the game. Michael Penix Jr. ran three times for 50 yards, the most of his career, which the team reads as a good sign for his knee after last year's ACL surgery. Watch the practice reports this week for any changes ahead of Kansas City.

stories.text: Penix runs for a career high 50 yards in Madrid
stories.summary: Penix finished 20 of 31 for 162 yards with one touchdown and one interception. His 23-yard scramble in the first quarter was the longest run of his career, and Next Gen Stats clocked him at 19.37 mph. The mobility gave Atlanta a threat it lacked in the 16-0 loss to Tampa Bay a week earlier, when he threw four interceptions.

stories.text: 880: Bijan Robinson's NFL-leading rushing total
stories.summary: Robinson ran for 100 yards against Cincinnati and has 880 on the season, the most in the league. He also scored his 30th career rushing touchdown, tying him for sixth in franchise history. His 6,778 scrimmage yards through 60 games trail only William Andrews in Falcons history.

stories.text: Chiefs visit Atlanta on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: Kansas City comes to Atlanta on Sunday, Nov. 15, with kickoff at 1:00 p.m. ET on CBS. The Falcons need to clean up pre-snap penalties and field goals, the two problems that defined the Madrid loss.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.headline: Panthers lose third straight to Denver

stories.text: Replay flips a Panthers drive in 26-21 loss to Denver
stories.summary: Carolina fell to 3-5 with its third straight loss. In the third quarter, Bryce Young's goal-line pass was first ruled incomplete, then a review of Sean Payton's challenge showed the flag came before the snap, and Denver safety Devon Key got credit for an interception. The Broncos then drove 80 yards in 14 plays, and Nik Bonitto's strip-sack with 1:24 left sealed it.

stories.text: Panthers play without their top four cornerbacks
stories.summary: Carolina met Denver without its top four cornerbacks and drew seven penalties, five of them for pass interference. Todd Wash called his first game as interim defensive coordinator in that condition. The team has not reported any new injuries from the game, so watch Wednesday's practice report for returns.

stories.text: Young throws three touchdowns in a losing effort
stories.summary: Young went 28 of 39 for 276 yards and three touchdown passes with one interception, and he took three sacks. Darren Waller caught eight passes for 90 yards and a 15-yard score, and Tetairoa McMillan hauled in a 4-yard touchdown with 3:05 left. Carolina scored enough to win most days but could not get a stop late.

stories.text: 31: years Todd Wash has coached, now running the defense
stories.summary: Wash took over as interim defensive coordinator after serving as defensive line coach for four seasons. He ran Jacksonville's defense from 2016 to 2020 and led three top 10 units, including the 2017 team that reached the AFC title game. He also worked in Seattle with head coach Dave Canales and general manager Dan Morgan.

stories.text: Panthers visit the Saints on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: Carolina plays at New Orleans on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 1:00 p.m. ET on FOX. Both teams sit at 3-5, so the winner takes sole possession of first place in the division. Watch whether Wash's group can hold up in coverage without its regular cornerbacks.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.headline: Saints stop 2-point try, win in overtime

stories.text: Saints beat Browns 23-22 in overtime
stories.summary: Juwan Johnson caught a 15-yard touchdown from Tyler Shough with 4:17 left in overtime, and New Orleans stopped Cleveland's two-point try to win 23-22. The Saints moved to 3-5 and picked up their first home win of the season. A win over Carolina this Sunday would give them sole possession of first place in the NFC South.

stories.text: Center Erik McCoy hurts his biceps
stories.summary: McCoy left late in the fourth quarter with a biceps injury and is being evaluated this week. A biceps injury ended his 2025 season after seven games, and the team expects him to miss some games rather than the season. William Sherman is the likely replacement, and Cesar Ruiz could slide over from guard. Left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. returned after missing five games with an ankle sprain.

stories.text: Carl Granderson piles up two more sacks
stories.summary: Granderson had two of the Saints' five sacks of Shedeur Sanders and now has 7.5 on the season. Kellen Moore called the pass rush relentless. Chase Young, Kaden Elliss and Khristian Boyd also got to Sanders as the Browns quarterback threw for 297 yards in place of the injured Deshaun Watson.

stories.text: 68.8%: Saints' field goal rate ranks 31st
stories.summary: Only one team kicks worse than the Saints, who also rank 26th in rushing at 95.3 yards per game and 28th in turnover margin at minus 6. Charlie Smyth hit three field goals against Cleveland, including a 48-yarder in the fourth quarter. Moore told reporters the playoff conversation has a long way to go.

stories.text: Panthers visit the Superdome on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: New Orleans hosts Carolina on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 1:00 p.m. ET on FOX. A win puts the Saints alone atop the division. Watch the center spot and whether Travis Etienne returns from injured reserve.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.headline: Bucs fall to Bears on walk-off field goal

stories.text: Bears beat Buccaneers 27-24 on Cairo Santos kick
stories.summary: Tampa Bay fell behind 14-0, rallied to tie it at 24, and lost on Cairo Santos's 38-yard field goal as time ran out. The Bucs dropped to 3-6. Baker Mayfield threw two interceptions, including a 67-yard pick-six by Jaylon Johnson, and the offense went 2 for 12 on third down.

stories.text: Antoine Winfield Jr. leaves with ankle injury
stories.summary: Winfield left the Chicago game with an ankle injury, and Ifeatu Melifonwu filled in and recovered a fumble. Receiver Emeka Egbuka came back from a two-game absence with a foot injury and caught three passes for 38 yards. The bye week gives Winfield time to heal.

stories.text: Zyon McCollum picks off two more passes
stories.summary: McCollum intercepted Caleb Williams twice and added five tackles. He has picked off a pass in three straight games and has four interceptions this season. Alex Anzalone also has four, the most among front-seven players in the league.

stories.text: 21: Tampa Bay's league-high takeaways
stories.summary: The Bucs forced five turnovers in Chicago, four of them Williams interceptions, and lead the NFL with 21 takeaways and 16 interceptions. Williams set a career high with four picks. Tampa Bay still lost because it committed eight penalties, five of them false starts.

stories.text: Bucs are on bye, then travel to Detroit
stories.summary: Tampa Bay is off in Week 10. The Bucs play at Detroit in Week 11 and host Carolina on Monday, Nov. 30, at 8:15 p.m. ET in Week 12. Time and network for the Lions game were not listed in the source.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.headline: Minshew's elbow may end his year; Beck is next

stories.text: Minshew faces likely season-ending elbow surgery
stories.summary: Gardner Minshew is seeking second opinions on a torn UCL in his throwing arm, and NFL Network reports he likely needs season-ending surgery. He got hurt on a late second-quarter strip-sack in the 17-3 loss at Seattle but stayed in and finished 21 of 30 for 166 yards. The Cardinals are 3-6 and last in the NFC West.

stories.text: Roy Lopez leaves with a toe injury, Wilson is done for the year
stories.summary: Defensive lineman Roy Lopez hurt his toe early in the second quarter in Seattle and did not return. Receiver Michael Wilson is already out for the season with a neck injury, which leaves the offense thin around its next quarterback.

stories.text: Carson Beck likely gets his first NFL start
stories.summary: The third-round rookie would likely start Week 10 against the Rams. His only live preseason work came in the Hall of Fame Game, where he went 15 of 19 for 188 yards and a touchdown. Arizona also signed veteran Josh Johnson from the Bengals practice squad.

stories.text: 11: straight losses to Seattle
stories.summary: The 17-3 defeat at Lumen Field extended Arizona's losing streak against the Seahawks to 11 games. The offense scored only a 28-yard Chad Ryland field goal and finished 3-6 on the season.

stories.text: Rams visit Arizona on Sunday afternoon
stories.summary: Arizona hosts the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 4:05 PM ET on CBS. Watch the quarterback decision and how a rookie handles the Rams pass rush, with Myles Garrett back from injury.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.headline: Nacua likely headed to IR after knee sprains

stories.text: Nacua likely to miss at least four games
stories.summary: Puka Nacua had an MRI Monday that showed MCL and PCL sprains plus turf toe, and coach Sean McVay said the team expects to place him on injured reserve. He got hurt on the final offensive snap of the 20-13 win at Washington. McVay said the Rams will look to add receiver depth.

stories.text: Avila out with hamstring, Adams already on IR
stories.summary: Left guard Steve Avila hurt his hamstring in the second quarter at Washington and was downgraded to out. Beaux Limmer replaced him. Receiver Davante Adams is already on injured reserve, so the passing game loses both top targets.

stories.text: Garrett returns from knee surgery with three sacks
stories.summary: Myles Garrett played his first game back from knee surgery and finished with three sacks, a forced fumble, three quarterback hits and three tackles for loss. The Rams have won three straight and sit at 5-4.

stories.text: 0-for-9: Rams on third down before the late turnaround
stories.summary: The Rams missed on their first nine third-down tries at Washington and did not convert until 2:48 remained in the third quarter. Matthew Stafford finished 26 of 43 for 228 yards, one touchdown and one interception.

stories.text: At Arizona on Sunday, then a bye
stories.summary: The Rams play at the Cardinals on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 4:05 PM ET on CBS. Arizona may start a rookie quarterback. The Rams then have a Week 11 bye and host Green Bay in Week 12.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.headline: Niners go 7-1 with five takeaways, lose Halton

stories.text: 49ers beat Raiders 38-17 and move to 7-1
stories.summary: San Francisco forced five turnovers, including three Kirk Cousins interceptions and a pick-six by Jaden Dugger on the first play of the second half. The Niners led 21-10 at halftime on three drives of 12 plays or more. They lead the NFC West by 2.5 games.

stories.text: Halton heads to IR with a broken ankle
stories.summary: Defensive lineman Gracen Halton suffered a fractured and dislocated ankle, will have surgery this week and goes on injured reserve. Kyle Shanahan said he would be surprised if Halton returned in the postseason. Renardo Green (back) and Deommodore Lenoir (foot) are day-to-day, and Deebo Samuel Sr. and C.J. West should practice Wednesday. Mike Evans is not expected back this week.

stories.text: Purdy throws for 232 and runs for 40
stories.summary: Brock Purdy went 17 of 25 for 232 yards and two touchdowns with one interception, and added 40 yards on seven carries. One of those touchdown passes went 37 yards to Jordan Watkins for his first NFL score.

stories.text: 5: takeaways against Las Vegas
stories.summary: The 49ers took the ball away five times, three on Cousins interceptions and two on fumble recoveries. The Raiders turned it over on each of their last four possessions and have lost five of their last six games.

stories.text: At Dallas on Sunday afternoon
stories.summary: San Francisco visits the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 4:25 PM ET on FOX. Watch how the defensive line holds up without Halton, with Nick Bosa and DeForest Buckner both back in the lineup.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.headline: Seahawks win 17-3 with backup QB Lock hurting

stories.text: Seahawks beat Arizona 17-3 behind Drew Lock
stories.summary: Backup Drew Lock started with Sam Darnold sidelined and went 19 of 28 for 175 yards and a touchdown. Tight end AJ Barner scored both of Seattle's touchdowns. The Seahawks improved to 5-4.

stories.text: Quarterback room is banged up
stories.summary: Darnold was ruled out with a quad injury, and coach Mike Macdonald said he also cracked a rib. Lock hurt his oblique during the game and called it not too bad, after he had been limited in practice with elbow tendinitis. Leonard Williams (stinger), Rashid Shaheed (knee) and Uchenna Nwoso (ankle) were out before kickoff.

stories.text: AJ Barner scores twice for the first time this year
stories.summary: Barner ran one yard for a touchdown and caught a seven-yard score, both in the second quarter. Those were his first two touchdowns of the season.

stories.text: 1,036: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's receiving yards
stories.summary: Smith-Njigba caught seven passes for 51 yards against Arizona, which pushed his season total to 1,036 receiving yards through nine games.

stories.text: At Las Vegas on Sunday afternoon
stories.summary: Seattle visits the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 15, at 4:05 PM ET on CBS. Watch the quarterback health report first, since Darnold and Lock are both dealing with injuries.
